fixtures.action: Create a Thing from a blank Stage.
fixtures.expect: One SMX-023 semantic transaction publishes a new ProjectRevisionId and stable ThingId.

fixtures.action: Change selection and Inspect visibility.
fixtures.expect: Editor state changes without advancing the canonical ProjectRevisionId or entering authored state.

fixtures.action: Group two existing Things.
fixtures.expect: Existing ThingIds are preserved and only explicit containment relationships are added.

fixtures.action: Attempt grouping with one unknown Thing.
fixtures.expect: Whole transaction fails; no group or partial containment is published.

fixtures.action: Make an ordinary group reusable.
fixtures.expect: A local Definition/Instance is created while the first concrete ThingIds remain unchanged.

fixtures.action: Instantiate the local reusable Definition.
fixtures.expect: The new instance receives independent concrete ThingIds while sharing Definition semantics.

fixtures.action: Attach beginner Rule and Behaviour projections with equivalent actions.
fixtures.expect: Both lower through the SMX-026 versioned constrained IR rather than separate interpreters.

fixtures.action: Submit an unsupported Rule action.
fixtures.expect: Compilation fails before a Behaviour attachment is published.

fixtures.action: Connect an event output to a command input.
fixtures.expect: Connection records stable ThingId + PortId endpoints and canonical ConnectionId.

fixtures.action: Use a hierarchy path as a PortId.
fixtures.expect: Stable semantic identity validation rejects it before publication.

fixtures.action: Connect to a missing target port.
fixtures.expect: Connection transaction rolls back atomically with no partial record.

fixtures.action: Use a Behaviour without any Timeline track.
fixtures.expect: Non-Timeline interactivity remains a first-class valid project.

fixtures.action: Add optional Timeline keyframes to an authored Thing property.
fixtures.expect: Track targets stable ThingId/property semantics and does not create behavioural ownership.

fixtures.action: Attempt to target Timeline through implementation-locator vocabulary.
fixtures.expect: The authoring boundary rejects the target without advancing the project revision.

fixtures.action: Import media with complete source/media/provenance/licence/derivation metadata.
fixtures.expect: A stable AssetId selects one digest-bound indivisible ProtectedAssetRevision and the Thing references that exact revision.

fixtures.action: Import media with incomplete provenance metadata.
fixtures.expect: Import fails atomically with neither Asset nor Thing published.

fixtures.action: Attempt to reuse an existing AssetId for competing source bytes.
fixtures.expect: Existing immutable revision remains authoritative and no competing Thing is published.

fixtures.action: Mix one protected revision field while retaining the old revision digest.
fixtures.expect: SMX-024 validation rejects the synthetic field-mixed revision.

fixtures.action: Submit transport/session authority in authored state.
fixtures.expect: Canonical validation rejects transient authority and leaves the old project revision unchanged.

fixtures.action: Render the ordinary Stage and Thing tools.
fixtures.expect: Basic author UI requires SplashMX vocabulary and contains no engine/build/package implementation terminology.

fixtures.action: Inspect a stable ConnectionId in the author projection.
fixtures.expect: R-019-01 remains enforced: semantic ConnectionId survives while transport connection identity remains non-canonical.

fixtures.action: Drive create/group/reuse/ports/connect/Rule/Behaviour/Timeline/Inspect in real Chromium.
fixtures.expect: The browser remains a thin action/view projection over the production transaction boundary.

fixtures.action: Send an invalid connection request through the browser bridge.
fixtures.expect: Typed failure is returned and the canonical connection set is unchanged.

fixtures.action: Send incomplete protected-media metadata through the browser bridge.
fixtures.expect: Typed failure is returned and neither canonical Thing nor protected Asset is published.
